integrity: Proof and reproducible finite checks supplied, with citations separating prior formulas from the newly assessed parameter classification.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive stepsize and curvature interval; uncertainty concerns worst single modal stationary variance with additive curvature-independent noise, not trace performance or transient rate. Existing literature already contains the scalar variance and endpoint-equalization techniques. Independent external mathematical review and exhaustivity of literature have not been established.
title: Exact fixed-step minimax noise tuning of signed heavy-ball momentum
